const ALLOWED = new Map([["docs", "https://docs.example.com/feed.json"]]);

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  const feed = ALLOWED.get(searchParams.get("feed") ?? "") ?? "https://docs.example.com/feed.json";
  const preview = await fetch(feed);
  return new Response(await preview.text());
}
